params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of items per page.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order: asc or desc.

items.docs:
Returns a paginated list of content items with their bundle storage
aggregates. Useful for identifying which content items consume the
most storage.

Results can be sorted by total bundle bytes, active bundle bytes,
inactive bundle bytes, or bundle count.

This endpoint requires authentication and is only available to users
with the `administrator` role.

Returns detailed storage information for a specific content item,
including per-bundle size data.

This endpoint requires authentication and is only available to users
with the `administrator` role.
